|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Unit Control

|descr= Forces a helicopter landing. If there is a helipad nearby, the helicopter will attempt to land on it. VTOL he other hand will just land somewhere. To make helicopter or VTOL land on a specific helipad use [[landAt]].

|s1= helicopter [[land]] mode

|p1= helicopter: [[Object]] helicopter or VTOL

|p2= mode: [[String]] - can be one of:
* "LAND" - Complete stop
* "GET IN" - Hovering very low, for another unit to get in
* "GET OUT" - Hovering low, for another unit to get out
* {{GVI|arma2|1.00|size= 0.75}} "NONE" - Cancel a landing

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_cobraOne land "LAND";</sqf>

|seealso= [[landAt]] [[allAirports]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Hardrock
|timestamp= 20060804105600
|text= ''Notes from before the conversion:''
Helos will land at the nearest "H" or "Invisible H", if there is one around (within 500m in {{arma1}}).
}}

{{Note
|user= SNKMAN
|timestamp= 20100926120200
|text= To make a helicopter LAND correctly and not hovering over the landing position use [[unitReady]] to check if the helicopter already has reached his destination.
You can fix a landing bug by using a short delay bevore checking the [[unitReady]] command.

<sqf>
_helicopter move getPosATL _destination;
sleep 3;
while { alive _helicopter && not unitReady _helicopter } do
{
	sleep 1;
};

if (alive _helicopter) then
{
	_helicopter land "LAND";
};
</sqf>
}}
